tasks.short: Grade and sort agricultural products by their physical characteristics and quality.

steps.what: Check the lot and applicable product-grade criteria in a native reference view
Inspect products by appearance, size, feel, smell and relevant quality characteristics
Physically sort products into the correct processing or usage groups
Write actual batch grading totals and quality exceptions
Check and approve the actual batch grading note
Save the approved actual batch grading note

tasks.design: Configure a native product/lot grade-reference view in {OPS_SYSTEM}, retaining criteria reading and all physical inspection/sorting. Separately write/check the actual batch outcome before its record save. No camera classifier, robot sorting or model-based smell/feel judgement is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical quality and correct usage cannot be established from a lot identifier.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved grade criteria can be shown with the selected product lot.
tasks.still_hard: Condition, mixed quality and subtle defects require direct sensory inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a defect that a simple size or colour rule does not explain.
tasks.altitude: Small lookup/posting savings with unchanged physical grading.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native lot/grade reference view can show existing approved criteria without judging physical agricultural product quality.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual criteria lookup and note posting; an existing native reference view earns no new saving. If no batch note exists, do not invent its saving.

Quality owner supplies existing product_id, grade_scheme, criteria_version and explicit criteria; receiving staff supplies lot identity in the current workflow. s1 grader verifies the lot/criteria in retained time. Missing criteria require manual clarification; no free new rule coding.

Grader produces actual decisions/counts during s2/s3 and separately captures lot_id, actual grade totals, unit, exceptions and observation_time in s4 at full time. s5 approves the complete note before a1; edits revoke approval.
This batch outcome record is distinct from tag/shipping identification entry in the adjacent task; the same actual record action must not be added twice. Native reference/form features precede code.
research_questions: Can the existing lot screen show the approved criteria without new data capture or classification?

approvals.approved_version: s5 final actual batch grading note and lot reference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 3 criteria-navigation and 2 save hours minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Low halves navigation and keeps save manual: 1.5 minus 0.5 = 1. Physical inspection/sorting unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record grade and identification numbers on tags or shipment, receipt and sales sheets.

steps.what: Verify lot identity and the actual assigned grade against the products
inputs: existing actual lot and grade records

steps.what: Capture and check grade, identification, quantity and intended tag or sheet destination
Populate candidate tags and shipment, receipt or sales sheets from exact checked fields
outputs: candidate lot identification tags and sheets

steps.what: Approve complete tag and sheet contents, lot linkage and selected printer
inputs: candidate lot identification tags and sheets
outputs: approved final lot identification tags and sheets

steps.what: Print the approved final lot identification tags
inputs: approved final lot identification tags and sheets

steps.what: Check printed tags and physically attach each to the correct product group
Record actual tag application and approve the final identification sheet record
inputs: approved final lot identification tags and sheets
outputs: approved actual lot identification sheet record

steps.what: Commit the approved actual identification sheet record
inputs: approved actual lot identification sheet record
outputs: filed actual lot identification sheet record

tasks.design: Configure native label/sheet templates in {OPS_SYSTEM} to populate exact already-checked grade and identification fields. Keep original identity capture, final content review and physical tag matching/attachment human. Approved tag printing and final actual sheet commit are separate gated actions, with actual application recorded before the latter.
tasks.previous_blocker: A correct grade number is useless if attached to the wrong product group.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse one checked field set on tags and identification sheets.
tasks.still_hard: Physical lot matching and actual tag application require attention.
tasks.human_edge: Catch a label/lot mismatch before goods move to the wrong destination.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated number transcription with unchanged identity checks and tagging.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native label templates can render exact checked lot and grade fields on tags and related records.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish actual repeated tag/sheet transcription and print-launch effort; existing template printing earns no new saving. Printer runtime is not human labour.

Existing grading/receiving staff produce lot/grade facts. s1/s2 focal grader verifies/captures lot_id, product_id, grade_id, identification_number, quantity, unit, output_type and destination at full time. No camera or free structured extraction supplies missing identity.

s3 only maps those fields. s4 checks complete tag/sheet content and printer before a1 binds the final print job. s6 retains print quality, lot matching and physical attachment. Wrong tags require actual correction/reapproval, not automatic release.

s7 separately records actual applied quantity, exceptions and source tag job, then checks/approves the complete sheet before a2. Native template/print/record functions precede code. No external shipping send is implied by an internal identification record.
research_questions: Does the current lot system already render the same checked numbers on both tags and identification sheets?

incremental.description: Check label/sheet field and printer mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 final tag contents and selected printer
s7 complete actual identification sheet record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 20 repeated tag/sheet transcription, 5 print-launch and 2 record-post hours minus 1 upkeep = 26. Low halves transcription benefit and keeps print/post manual: 10 minus 1 = 9. Physical tagging unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain physical grading and lot checks while native records handle explicit identifiers.
reach: Help handling colleagues trace actual product grades and tag application to the correct lot.
role.ambitious_version: A grader who spends less time repeating numbers and keeps attention on the actual products and their correct identification.
